title: US Pentagon chief Hegseth signs military deal in Venezuela, meets Delcy Rodriguez after Maduro's ouster
paragraphs: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth visited Venezuela on Wednesday, met with the country's interim authorities and also signed a military cooperation deal with the Latin American country.
What do we know so far about Hegseth's trip?
The Pentagon did not release any information on Hegseth's trip or confirm the visit, although it was broadcast on Venezuelan state media.
